name: opm
description: An opinionated engineering workflow for Claude Code: brainstorm -> plan -> TDD execution with fresh-context subagents -> verification -> captured learnings. Lean reviewers, stack-specific patterns for TypeScript/React, Python and Flutter, six light safety hooks, UI design skills with visual QA, and a narrated explainer-video skill. Visual QA uses the project's Playwright when present; otherwise it asks before downloading Playwright, axe-core and Chromium (about 150 MB) into ~/.opm/design-tools. The explainer video's neural voice (edge-tts) sends narration text to a Microsoft cloud service unless the local OS voice is chosen.
